title: Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines (Internal)
summary: This internal guide sets eligibility for provisional credit during credit card transaction disputes. It requires: account open ≥60 days; dispute reason in {'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge','duplicate_charge','goods_services_not_received' with purchase >30 days}; amount $25+ and within tier max ($2,500 Bronze/Eco/Business Bronze/Crypto; $5,000 Silver/Green/Zoom; $10,000 Gold; $15,000 Platinum; $25,000 Diamond); no more than 2 disputes in past 12 months; and merchant contact for non-fraud disputes.
